rationale: No supported optimization applies safely. Dependency caching is already provided by bundler-cache: true in both the test and lint jobs, so the cache-dependency pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) is essentially satisfied; moreover the closest cache experiment did not delete Gemfile.lock, whereas this workflow removes the lockfile before bundler-cache, defeating lockfile-keyed restore, and a safely placeable gemfile-keyed cache step cannot be added without risking an empty-cache save (if placed before install) or a wasted install followed by a restore (if placed after install). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true) is contraindicated: the matrix is intended to produce full cross-combination (OS x Ruby x gemfile) diagnostics and the summary job aggregates required test/lint results, so canceling remaining cells on failure would lose failure diagnostics and requires a separate required-status review. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE would require privileged write actions; P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is contraindicated by shared gemfiles/config; a custom timeout is already set (25 min). Preserving build/test coverage and required checks, no change is warranted.
